name: Midland ER310 emergency radio
summary: An AM/FM emergency radio with rechargeable, AA, hand-crank and supplementary solar power options. Canadian Weatheradio coverage is no longer available.
description: Keep the ER310 on the shortlist for listening to available local AM/FM broadcasts during an outage. Weather-band hardware and a working alert service are different things. Canada has discontinued Weatheradio, so a Canadian household should build its information plan around currently available services instead of assuming this radio will receive local weather alerts.

specs.label: Broadcast bands
specs.value: AM, FM and seven weather channels

specs.label: Charging options
specs.value: Micro-USB input, hand crank and built-in solar panel

specs.label: Battery options
specs.value: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery or six AA cells; AA cells are not recharged by the unit

specs.label: Solar limitation
specs.value: Midland says solar is supplementary and will not recharge a depleted battery by itself

pros: AM/FM reception does not require a phone data connection.
AA backup and USB charging offer alternatives to the internal battery.
cons: Canadian Weatheradio is no longer operating.
Hand-crank and solar charging are not substitutes for routine USB recharging.
The documented battery capacities differ and are not assigned to the supplied radio; no runtime or delivered capacity is guaranteed.
useCases: Listen to available local AM/FM outage updates.
Include radio charging and spare-cell checks in a household readiness routine.

confirmed.text: ECCC states that Weatheradio and Hello Weather are no longer in service.
The ER310 has AM/FM and weather-band reception; this is not the ER310PRO.
Midland documents BATT26L as a 2600 mAh replacement for second-generation ER310. That is not evidence that the conflicting guide values describe a verified shipment change.

unverifiedClaims: No guaranteed local weather alerts, battery runtime or phone recharge count is established.
The exact supplied battery capacity, current seller and box contents are not independently established. The ER310-MFN listing designation does not establish a battery revision.
safetyNotes: Do not promise Canadian weather-alert coverage. Reception of any available US NOAA signal is location-dependent and has not been tested.

Manufacturer materials conflict on capacity, including within the current guide. BATT26L is documented for second-generation ER310, but this does not establish a 2600/3500 revision history or the battery shipped under this ASIN. Use only the specified Midland pack.
